The '''Dahgee crystal''' was a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|Lightsaber crystal]] used by the [[Dahgee Jedi]] during the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The blades had unique properties, having a zigzagging pattern with a dark [[Silver/Legends|silver]] core and a [[Color/Legends|colored]] aura. They were often used in the [[Dahgee Jedi Lightsaber]].
